description:
## [1.14.0](https://github.com/browzomje/browzomje-patches/compare/v1.13.0...v1.14.0) (2026-10-18)

### ✨ New Features

* **Pinterest:** add startup screen selection, direct video downloader and improve video filtering ([9fd1db3](https://github.com/browzomje/browzomje-patches/commit/9fd1db3d3ce28f47880b499e358695528af04516))

patches.name: Choose startup tab
patches.description: Choose Home, Search or Saved for fresh launcher starts. Keeps deep links, notifications and restored sessions unchanged. Configure in Morphe settings.

patches.name: Copy direct link
patches.description: Adds a "Copy direct link" option to the pin menu, copying the direct CDN media link instead of the Pinterest web link.

patches.name: Disable AppsFlyer tracking
patches.description: Neutralises the AppsFlyer attribution SDK, so no install, event or uninstall data leaves the device.

patches.name: Disable Google Engage
patches.description: Stops Pinterest publishing your content to Google (Discover, Assistant, Play Store).

patches.name: Disable Google Engage worker
patches.description: Blocks the periodic Google Engage job, the other way content reaches Google.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored pins from the home, search, related and board feeds. Also carries the "Hide product pins" and "Hide board modules in search" filters, and the opt-in "Hide video pins" filter, all switchable from the Morphe settings screen.

patches.name: Disable email confirmation dialog
patches.description: Closes the "confirm your email" modal, and similar ones, when enabled in Morphe settings.

patches.name: Disable third-party trackers
patches.description: Turns off the embedded advertising and telemetry SDKs (AdMob, Bugsnag, Firebase, Privacy Sandbox) and strips the Advertising ID permission. Push notifications keep working.

patches.name: Download board
patches.description: Adds an option to the board's "…" menu to bulk download the images and videos of the loaded pins.

patches.name: Download images in highest available quality
patches.description: Checks for an original image before downloading, with automatic fallback to the largest available app variant.

patches.name: Download pin from long press
patches.description: Adds a download button to the circular menu you get by long-pressing a pin, so the image can be saved without opening it.

patches.name: Download video
patches.description: Adds a "Download video" option to the pin menu, saving the clip to the Downloads folder.

patches.name: Filter pin menu actions
patches.description: Hides selected native pin menu actions by their localized labels, one per line.

patches.name: Hide Create nav button
patches.description: Hides the "+" (create Pin) navigation button, when enabled in Morphe settings.

patches.name: Hide Notifications nav button
patches.description: Hides the notifications navigation button, when enabled in Morphe settings.

patches.name: Hide Search nav button
patches.description: Hides the search navigation button, when enabled in Morphe settings.

patches.name: Hide ad views
patches.description: Collapses Pinterest's ad-only views, so no ad chrome is drawn even if the app builds one. Follows the "Disable ads" switch.

patches.name: Hide comments
patches.description: Hides the pin comments section, the comment preview and the comments button, when the matching Morphe setting is enabled.

patches.name: Hide greeting header buttons
patches.description: Hides the create and inbox buttons in the home feed header, when the matching Morphe settings are enabled.

patches.name: Hide save for later tooltip
patches.description: Always hides the save-for-later education popup without disabling the Save button.

patches.name: Hide screenshot share menu
patches.description: Removes the panel Pinterest opens after a screenshot, and stops it watching for screenshots where possible.

patches.name: Hide search history
patches.description: Hides the "Recent searches" section on the search screen and below the search bar. Pinterest still logs searches server-side.

patches.name: Keep Home feed
patches.description: Keeps the Home feed when returning to Home instead of refreshing automatically. Pull-to-refresh remains available. Off by default and in the recommended preset; enable it in Morphe settings.

patches.name: Morphe runtime names
patches.description: Resolves the class Pinterest builds its toasts with, so Morphe's messages look like the app's own.

patches.name: Morphe settings entry
patches.description: Adds the "Morphe" item to the Account Settings list to open the toggle screen.

patches.name: Morphe settings screen (label)
patches.description: Renames the reused string resource for the "Morphe" entry in Settings, across all languages.

patches.name: Morphe settings screen (manifest)
patches.description: Registers the Morphe settings Activity in the manifest, with an intent-filter for the morphe:// scheme.

patches.name: Neutralize advertising ID
patches.description: Returns an empty Google Advertising ID and forces "limit ad tracking", without crashing the app.

patches.name: Open links in the default browser
patches.description: Opens links in the phone's default browser instead of Pinterest's in-app browser, when the matching Morphe setting is enabled.

patches.name: Sanitize copied links
patches.description: Turns the pin.it link that "Copy link" copies, whose slug identifies who shared it, into the plain pin link. Switchable from Morphe settings.

patches.name: Sanitize shared links
patches.description: Strips tracking parameters from the link on the Android share sheet and resolves pin.it short links to the plain pin link. Switchable from Morphe settings.

patches.name: Set pin as wallpaper
patches.description: Adds a "Set as wallpaper" option to the pin menu, which downloads the image and sets it as the device wallpaper.

patches.name: Show pin image information
patches.description: Shows optional image dimensions and format below the image or instead of like/comment actions.

patches.name: Use the system share sheet
patches.description: Opens the Android system share sheet instead of Pinterest's in-app share sheet, when the matching Morphe setting is enabled.

patches.name: Disable ad SDK
patches.description: Stops the AppLovin MAX mediation stack — and with it Pangle, Amazon APS, Chartboost, InMobi, Mintegral, Fyber, Bigo and the rest — from ever initialising. The game starts faster and makes no ad-network requests at all. Requires "Remove ads": on its own it would only make the app fail to find ads, not stop asking for them.

patches.name: Disable tracking
patches.description: Hands out an empty Google Advertising ID with "limit ad tracking" turned on, and stops AppsFlyer from sending install attribution and events. The game keeps working normally: nothing in it waits for attribution data.

patches.name: Instant rewards
patches.description: Grants the reward of every "watch an ad" button — hints, streak repairs, extra puzzles — immediately, without playing a video. This is what keeps those buttons working once "Remove ads" is enabled: without it the game believes no video is available and hands out nothing.

patches.name: Reclaim ad banner space
patches.description: Collapses the empty strip the banner used to occupy at the bottom of the board, so the puzzle gets the space back instead of staring at a blank rectangle. Only useful together with "Remove ads".

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Turns off every ad Easy Sudoku shows: the home banner, the interstitials between puzzles, the app-open ad and all the background preloading. It works by telling the game its own "ads removed" purchase is already active, which also unlocks the Fun, Ice and Killer Sudoku modes that are otherwise gated behind watching ads. Keep "Instant rewards" enabled too, or the "watch an ad for a hint" buttons stop giving anything.
